text.en: At the start of the first battle round, select one unit from your opponent’s army to be this model’s victim. Each time this model makes an attack that targets its victim, you can re-roll the Wound roll. Each time this model’s victim is destroyed, select one new enemy unit to be this model’s victim.

While a friendly WAR DOG model is within 9" of this model, each time that WAR DOG model makes an attack that targets the closest eligible target, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
